source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hello Rakhi, thank you for the reply.

I am a mother and this book is written from my experiences as well as borrowed experiences. My book is about how new parents can set boundaries without awkward conversations and how visitors can behave around a newborn and new parents. Its a guide that answers the question every new Indian parent is too exhausted to answer - 'When can you visit, how long can you stay, and please don't kiss my baby.' I have added checklists, Do's & Don'ts tables, and some anecdotes. This is my first time as an author and I would appreciate your help with getting this paperback published successfully. Basically I would need help in fine-tuning the book which would be a delight to readers and in successfully publishing this book.

Could you please help me with the below:
1\. How should we go about it ?
2\. Also, what would be the price and timelines for this ?

value_updates.guidance_goal: Advise the first-time author on how to publish the book successfully as a paperback.

Hello Rakhi, I just finished the review. Let me share my feedback:

1\. Page1 has only the image with no text. Is this how its supposed to be ? I mean for the cover, there wont be any texts? How would it be presented while printing ?
2\. Page 2 has only title, subtitle and author name. There is no image here. IS this how its supposed to be ?
3\. Published in India by "Being Mindful Parents". Can I change this later ?
4\. Images for the below chapter looks elongated. If you could let me know the size, I can try to generate the image in that size, it would not look weird.
\- Chapter2
\- Chapter4
\- Managing the In-Laws
\- For the Partner
5\. For Chapter7, the right top part of the image is cut. I can share this too once I have the proper size details
6\. I have removed full stop in the table text
7\. For Chapter12, the first line punctuation is different. What I mean is first letter of every word is in Caps. In the last revision, first line was like a subtitle and the subsequent lines were like body text (which started from a new line) which was in usual punctuation. But in this revision, since both the lines were on the same level, the punctuation of the first line feels off.
8\. I have edited some texts, nothing major. Track changes are available.
9\. Could you please help me with what front and back matter content are needed ? Or is there anything else needed for publishing ?
